_note: T166. Customer-style sentences for detectTagsNLP. `must`: the tag has to be found. `mustNot`: the tag has to be absent from `found` (a traps list: a synonym matching inside a longer word, or a phrase whose words are merely scattered through the text). `negated`: the tag has to land in `negated` and not in `found`. Written by hand from how customers type; every `must` entry is checked against the engine as it was BEFORE T166 as well (see TIMELINE T166), so an entry that fails on the new engine and passed on the old one is a regression and not a wish.
must: hang a shelf on my brick wall
need to drill into a concrete wall
mount my tv above the fireplace
my chair has a broken leg
water backing up in the shower
this is a complicated assembly with many pieces
there is a cracked tile in the bathroom
one broken tile near the tub
a chipped tile on the floor
I lost data on my laptop
need to recover files from a dead drive
my hard drive failure is bad
please dispose of the old unit
patch a hole in my drywall
there is no fan box in the ceiling
a light in the vaulted ceiling
cathedral ceiling in the living room
I have many items to mount
we will probably need to order parts
there is no parking on my street
a water line to the fridge
there is a water ring on my desk
I need a helper for this
pop ups everywhere on my screen
my laptop is a slow computer now
I want to mount on wall
there is a water stain on the ceiling
there is a wifi dead zone upstairs
weak wifi in the back room
mustNot: install crown molding in the living room
my stove has no burners work and won't power on
there is no leak in the toilet tank
replace flapper, fill valve, or handle to stop running or weak flush
knownGaps: negator over-reach: "won't" is read as a negation of "running" (filed in PENDING_DECISIONS; remove from knownGaps when fixed)
